categories.name: nvidia-peripherals
categories.description: NVIDIA Jetson and DRIVE hardware peripheral access

customDescriptions.value: Access camera and audio peripherals on NVIDIA Jetson/DRIVE platforms — use for video capture, image processing, or audio I/O in GPU-accelerated applications
Access communication interfaces on NVIDIA Jetson/DRIVE — use for I2C, SPI, UART, or CAN bus communication with external devices
Read GPIO pin state on NVIDIA Jetson — use for reading digital input signals from buttons, switches, or external sensors
Write GPIO pin state on NVIDIA Jetson — use for controlling LEDs, relays, or other digital output peripherals
Access IoT connectivity on NVIDIA Jetson — use for MQTT, ThingSpeak, or cloud data exchange in edge computing applications
Access network interfaces on NVIDIA Jetson/DRIVE — use for TCP/IP, UDP, or Ethernet communication in distributed computing systems
